text: On June 26 and 27, 2024, Toronto City Council authorized the initiation of expropriation proceedings for permanent and temporary easements in parts of the property municipally known as 396 St. Clair Avenue West for the purpose of constructing a permanent fire ventilation storage room at Toronto Transit Commission's St. Clair West Station (the "Project"). The Project forms a part of the Toronto Transit Commission's St. Clair West Station Fire Ventilation Upgrade Project. This report relates to the second stage of the expropriation process. During the first stage and in accordance with the Expropriations Act, Notices of Application for Approval to Expropriate were served on all applicable "registered owners," and published in the newspaper.
